user_requirement: Direct2D, DirectWrite and all DirectX must work in Win98 Modern alongside the required modern applications.

Direct3D 11: required Office startup and document editing

acceptance_rules: These scenarios are necessary smoke and functional checks, not an exhaustive API surface or a compatibility percentage.
Complete export and COM interface contracts, behavior, errors, ownership and unsupported cases require a separate source-backed inventory.
A DLL filename, resolved import, source build or successful factory return alone does not establish support.
Hardware versus software devices and feature levels must describe real backend capabilities.
Host pixel/resource evidence, actual guest ABI/rendering, native Windows 98 integration and application functionality remain separate verdicts.
Preserve original disks, corpora, source/license lineage and the unchanged reserve/write/output limits.

first_observed_application_blocker.actual_current_result: Missing normal import prevents the application process from starting; DXGI is also required.
